raw_membership: all registered hourly rows from exactly one station CSV
omega: the ordered, finite-or-missing daily canonical PM2.5 state vector for one station
emergent_time_semantics: first preregistered N-day operation depth at which eligible station parents separate from their own matched nulls; not physical time
emergent_scale_semantics: survival of that separation across contiguous N-day depths and frozen domain-meaningful sensor perturbations
matched_null_child: one within-station permutation of complete daily records inside each calendar year-month stratum
mainstream_baseline: station-local monthly climatology plus AR(1), trained on the first 75 percent of ordered eligible days
weakens_tld: separation is attributable to one parent
separation disappears after the frozen climatology-plus-AR(1) control
neutral_or_not_applicable: cyclic adjacency differs from the primary linear result
recovery or ringing, which are not registered domain endpoints
